postReview.description: Noah Atubolu went from hero to villain in Freiburg's Europa League loss to Braga, saving a first-half penalty then making a costly mistake.

postReview.title: Braga 2-1 Freiburg: Atubolu comete un error decisivo en la semifinal tras detener un penalti
